title: Canonical scalar universality gives the Cartier scalar unit
statement: Let R,S be commutative rings in Type (u+1), phi:R→S a ring homomorphism, and Z a scheme in universe u. For pro-etale module sheaves F over R and G over S and eta:F→Res(phi)(G), scalarUniversal [def-geo-exact-degree-zero-interface] implies GeoCartierScalarUnit [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface] for the same map. Both properties test all unbounded complexes; there is no flatness or finiteness hypothesis.

proof.text: Apply scalarUniversal_derivedUnit to express canonical scalar universality in the abstract exact-functor interface. In a general pair of abelian categories with chosen derived categories, associativity identifies its three-arrow composition with the first two arrows parenthesized together. Specialize this proved categorical identity to restriction of scalars. Unfold GeoCartierScalarUnit and IsDerivedBaseChange; their defining formula is precisely the resulting one. All unbounded test complexes are retained.

lean.statement:
theorem geoCartierScalarUnit_of_scalarUniversal
    {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (φ : R →+* S) (Z : Scheme.{u})
    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))
    (G : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S))
    (η : F ⟶ (Sheaf.restrictScalars (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) φ).obj G)
    (h : SheafExactDegreeZero.scalarUniversal (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) φ F G η) :
    GeoCartierScalarUnit φ Z F G η
